handTracking.note: Nonessential joint loss hides the full hand renderer while interaction remains tracked; reacquisition can raise another pinch edge without a physical opening.

handHandoff.note: Actual main-demo pinch polling loses the new hand edge when the previously active hand was also pinching.

panelTimer.note: No button release was delivered. Real panel drag/slider ownership can override this timer; ordinary button gestures cannot.

mapRecovery.note: Same pressed grip recaptures after tracking loss without release.

emissive.note: Changing only emissive/intensity has no shader input effect; this is how the control Orb toggles/pulses its light.
